| Wells Fargo | India Head of Chief Data Office, Technology Executive | Bengaluru, India | Posted 2 Days Ago | onsite | full-time | lead | Posting End Date: 04/23/2026 | Banking / Financial Services | About this role: Wells Fargo is seeking a India Head of Chief Data Office – Technology Executive. Wells Fargo Technology Technology at Wells Fargo enables the company to serve millions of customers globally through secure, resilient, and innovative platforms. Wells Fargo Technology partners across lines of business to deliver scalable solutions that support regulatory expectations, risk management, and business outcomes. Chief Data Office The Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for defining and delivering Wells Fargo’s enterprise data strategy, including data governance, data platforms, analytics enablement, and responsible AI. The CDO partners closely with Technology, Risk, and Business leaders to modernize the data ecosystem while maintaining strong controls and regulatory compliance. Role Overview The Head of CDO India is a senior executive responsible for leading and modernizing Enterprise Data Governance, Assets, Analytics, and Technology across India. This role is a key member of the global CDO leadership and Technology I&P leadership teams and serves as the senior accountable leader for CDO delivery in India, overseeing delivery of scalable, compliant, and modern data capabilities aligned to enterprise strategy, regulatory expectations, and business outcomes. This executive provides end-to-end accountability for CDO execution in India, including data governance, enterprise data strategy execution, technology modernization, analytics enablement, and risk management. The role leads large, globally distributed teams and strategic vendor partners and represents India technology capabilities within global CDO and Wells Fargo Technology forums. In this role, you will: Provide vision and set direction for all of technology development and infrastructure or service component for a defined business unit Manage and allocate appropriate people and financial resources to ensure that projects are completed within committed time and budget, and align with strategic objectives Develop and monitor long range information technology plans and policies consistent with the strategic objectives and plans of the business unit Identify capacity planning, efficiency, availability, business enablement and time to market Provide comprehensive consultation to more experienced management regarding business requirements Recommend innovations which anticipate the future directions of both business and information technology Provide technology solutions for the large business unit, including application portfolio standardization and rationalization Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including more experienced managers Lead team to achieve objectives Interface with external agencies, regulatory bodies or industry forums Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Technology Strategic Leadership Develop and guide a culture of talent development to meet business objectives and strategy Required Qualifications: 10+ years of Technology Strategic Leadership experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education 6+ years of Management experience Desired Qualifications: Executive leadership experience in large, highly regulated financial services organizations. Experience in data strategy, governance, and tooling leadership in the financial services industry, preferably in a large-scale enterprise environment. Proven success leading enterprise-scale data and analytics platform modernization. Strong background in technology risk management, controls, and regulatory engagement. Experience operating in product-centric and agile delivery models. Demonstrated ability to lead transformation, manage ambiguity, and drive change at scale. Job Expectations: CDO Strategy & Execution Define and execute multi-year CDO strategies for India, aligned with global Enterprise Data Strategy, Wells Fargo Technology priorities, and regulatory expectations. Serve as the senior accountable leader across India for managing CDO’s business to drive outcomes, including data governance, tooling, platforms, and analytics. Translate Enterprise Data Strategy into scalable, executable technology outcomes with measurable business impact. Drive execution across all the pillars of the Enterprise Data Strategy. Represent CDO India organization in global leadership, investment, and governance forums. Partner with other CIO I&P leaders to solve horizon technology issues. Drive a culture of innovation and use of AI to simplify and automate CDO processes. Enterprise Data Platforms Own delivery and modernization of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including cloud-based and on-prem solutions. Drive application rationalization, platform consolidation, and simplification to reduce complexity, cost, and operational risk. Improve time to market, scalability, resiliency, performance, and cost efficiency of data technology services. Ensure technology solutions are designed for reuse, standardization, and enterprise-wide adoption. CDO Shared Services Drive scalable shared data technology capabilities for CDO, including Information Architecture, AI enablement and delivery, shared technology development, and production management services. Enterprise Data Simplification and Management Drive a rationalized and consistent approach to aggregating, provisioning and consuming data through Approved Data Sources (ADSs) across the enterprise. Support simplification of the enterprise data environment through establishment of ADSs and reducing data duplication. Enterprise Data Governance Drive execution of enterprise data strategy, adoption of Data Management Policy and Procedures, and effectiveness of the Data Management Risk scorecard. Ensure strong data risk management, including data quality, metadata, lineage, transparency, controls, and issue remediation. Improve data literacy through delivery of comprehensive role-based training program Corporate Functions Domain Partner across the Corporate Functions to ensure adherence to the Data Management Policy and Procedures, while advancing simplification efforts Enterprise Data Assets & Solutions Enable business growth and cost efficiency through delivery of centrally-governed, consumable suite of enriched data products and enterprise authorized data sources Drive enhancement and execution of data governance tooling strategy delivering and integrated enterprise tool for efficient governance, compliance, and centralized data management Issues Management Act as a senior escalation point for material data technology and data risk issues impacting India delivery. Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and Issues Management teams to ensure regulatory readiness and audit sustainability. Embed governance and control expectations into technology delivery, analytics enablement, and vendor services. Enterprise Analytic Enablement Enable advanced analytics and AI through trusted, governed, and scalable analytics platforms and capabilities. Deliver best in class analytical solutions enabling business insights to drive revenue generation. Partner with analytics and AI leaders to support responsible, compliant, and secure AI enablement. Ensure analytics platforms balance innovation and insight generation with strong governance and control discipline. People, Operating Model & Vendor Leadership Lead and develop large, globally distributed data, technology and engineering teams across India. Build a high-performance, inclusive culture focused on talent development, succession planning, continuous learning, and campus recruiting. Establish a scalable operating model that supports product-centric delivery and agile execution. Oversee strategic vendor and partner relationships, ensuring performance, financial discipline, and risk management. Drive a culture in the region that shifts mindset from execution to ownership improving overall engagement Critical Leadership Capabilities Strategic Thinking: Translates enterprise data strategy into executable outcomes at scale. Driving Results: Delivers high-quality, resilient platforms with strong accountability and operational rigor. Collaborating & Influencing: Partners effectively across Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Business leaders globally. Building People Capability: Develops diverse, high-performing technology teams and future leaders. Posting End Date: 23 Apr 2026 *Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants. This is a partner-facing, hands-on role responsible for delivering high-impact analytics and AI/ML solutions across the end-to-end model lifecycle ranging from problem framing and model development to implementation, monitoring, and governance. The role serves as a technical subject matter expert and advisor, ensuring models are performant, explainable, and compliant with internal standards and banking regulatory expectations. This role also supports Advice & Planning capabilities by developing and validating goal-based planning, funding optimization, and simulation-based testing frameworks to improve customer outcomes under varying market conditions. In this role, you will: Perform highly complex activities related to creation, implementation, and documentation Use highly complex statistical theory to quantify, analyze and manage markets Forecast losses and compute capital requirements providing insights, regarding a wide array of business initiatives Utilize structured securities and provide expertise on theory and mathematics behind the data Manage market, credit, and operational risks to forecast losses and compute capital requirements Participate in the discussion related to analytical strategies, modeling and forecasting methods Identify structure to influence global assessments, inclusive of technical, audit and market perspectives Collaborate and consult with regulators, auditors and individuals that are technically oriented and have excellent communication skills Required Qualifications: 4+ years of Quantitative Analytics experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education Master's degree or higher in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, economics, or computer science Desired Qualifications: Strong programming and data skills: Python, PySpark, SQL; experience working with large datasets. Solid ML/statistical foundation: regression (linear/logistic), time series, multivariate analysis; tree/ensemble methods (RF, XGBoost/GBM), SVM; and practical understanding of model evaluation and tuning (e.g., AUC/ROC). Strong applied quantitative modeling background, including optimization and/or simulation techniques used in planning, allocation, or decisioning problems. Hands-on experience implementing optimization models (linear programming preferred) and translating objective functions and constraints into production-ready code. Solid understanding of uncertainty modeling and simulation (e.g., Monte Carlo), including summarizing distributional outcomes and stress/adverse-condition analysis. Experience in model deployment, UAT support, and model monitoring/maintenance in production. Strong analytical problem-solving and critical thinking; ability to learn business context quickly and collaborate across teams. Proven hands-on experience building and deploying ML solutions on GCP, with strong proficiency in BigQuery and Vertex AI (training and operationalization). Familiarity with Generative AI concepts (LLMs, embeddings, prompt-based systems) for awareness and future collaboration. Hands-on exposure to GenAI application prototyping and evaluation (e.g., prompting, retrieval concepts, embeddings/vector search, basic guardrails). Understanding of Responsible AI principles (fairness, explainability, data privacy) relevant to both traditional ML and emerging AI approaches. Deep learning exposure (ANN/RNN/CNN/LSTM) and/or frameworks such as TensorFlow/Keras/PyTorch. Big data ecosystem experience (Spark/Hadoop/H2O/Teradata/Aster) and experience optimizing pipelines with Data Engineering partners. Experience with stochastic process modeling relevant to markets (e.g., interest rates, inflation, correlations) and applying these in simulation frameworks. Experience building scalable simulation orchestration (parallelized runs; scenario/sampling frameworks; group-based experimentation). Familiarity with goal-based planning/advice engines: goal setup, contribution recommendations, funding source selection, monitoring for material changes, and personalized action generation. Banking domain familiarity (e.g., deposits, loans, cards, mortgage, wealth) and/or functional areas (risk, marketing, operations). Experience with end-to-end deployment practices including packaging, CI/CD integration, and production monitoring; familiarity with model lifecycle tooling such as experiment tracking, model registry, and automated drift/performance monitoring. Job Expectations: Lead end-to-end AI/ML initiatives: data analysis, feature engineering, model development, validation, performance testing, implementation, and monitoring. Build prototypes quickly to validate feasibility and business value; evolve prototypes into scalable, reusable solutions.
